updates.title: Technology Framework & Leveling System
updates.summary: Domain-based tech trees; 1–100 Levels; Lvl 90 ≈ 2020; three-letter domain codes; fixed-width; initiatives list one level; domains advance independently.
updates.details: (a) tech notation format is `XXX-N` and rendered in fixed-width, (b) domains advance independently, (c) level advancement triggers: milestones, research, infrastructure unlocks, systemic breakthroughs.

updates.title: Milestone Status Report Format & Rules
updates.summary: Required sections + tables; GDP smoothing; news style with in-game effect; advisors include one bad action; no timeline advance unless explicit.
updates.details: Required sections: News/Events, Completed/Imminent, In Progress, Planned (next 10), Completed Audits, Metrics, Advisors; tables required; Planned/In Progress exclude impact; Completed includes Effect/Impact; Metrics include Δ and Annualized with GDP row second.

updates.title: ZIP Availability Detection Rule
updates.summary: Run ZIP availability test before file-backed operations; sentinel check; downgrade to chat-canon if unavailable; trigger TBD.
updates.details: Verify zip path exists, open zip and list entries, verify sentinel file(s) (NR_SPEC.json). If fail: set mode to chat-canon only and prefix outputs with CANON_STATUS: ZIP_UNAVAILABLE. No user prompt.

updates.title: Timeline Advance Control
updates.summary: Only `next` or explicit request advances time; reports/status/MSR cannot advance timeline.
updates.details: `next` advances 3 days (if that is the campaign rule) and otherwise timeline is frozen unless explicit. If uncertain, write: 'advance interval defined by canon; default 3 days when `next` is used.'

updates.title: Initiative & Milestone ID Format
updates.details: 4-letter initiative code + tier number; milestone serial includes tier; all codes must be in fixed-width.

updates.title: Fixed-Font Tech Codes
updates.details: Render codes like `ENE-3` in fixed-width in all outputs.

updates.title: GDP Annualization Rule
updates.summary: Annualized GDP must smooth short-term spikes.
updates.details: Do not extrapolate raw short-window deltas; use smoothed trend; show Δ using symbol 'Δ'.
